entries.title: Site-scoped referral source report.
entries.notes: Use the disposable local/testing screenshot App with CAPELL_SCREENSHOT_FIXTURE and CAPELL_SCREENSHOT_APP_PATH set. The fixture seeds aggregate counts for existing sites without changing the capture administrator permissions. The administrator needs View:RefererPage and access to at least one seeded site. Capture the real last-30-days report; the selector refuses empty or unavailable reports.
entries.useCase: An administrator compares referral source counts and shares for the selected site.

notCaptured.reason: Core currently short-circuits HTML-cache hits before frontend site resolution and exposes no cache-hit extension hook, so this boundary remains documented as an integration gap.
